subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR advance the per-agent database to schema v12 while retiring the documented ACP `streamLogPath`, and if so what supported diagnostics contract replaces it?
rationale: This changes a persisted schema and a caller-visible ACP result contract; repository policy requires explicit acceptance for the schema bump, and the permanent diagnostics API cannot be selected safely by automated repair.

options.title: Approve with a stable diagnostics contract
options.body: Record schema-bump acceptance and require either compatible `streamLogPath` behavior or a documented supported query/API before merge.

options.title: Split the ACP contract change
options.body: Land only the approved journal migrations while deferring removal of the ACP diagnostics handle to a separately reviewed compatibility change.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the PR open without merge until ownership and upgrade guarantees for both contracts are agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve with a stable diagnostics contract
recommendation.body: Record schema-bump acceptance and require either compatible `streamLogPath` behavior or a documented supported query/API before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite work provides the closest established ownership context for per-agent schema migration decisions.
